verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Copilot Chat runs inside VS Code, JetBrains and Visual Studio [docs-4]. In the editor it explains concepts and proposes edits [docs-22], and it can pull in extra context through MCP servers and the GitHub MCP server directly in the IDE [docs-20, docs-25]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-IDE chat (community evidence covers completions, not chat), and chat support across all listed editors, since it is limited to three IDEs and excludes Neovim despite broader editor integration.
